headers: In the portal, the County requires bidders to "provide a written detailed list of exactly what is included in the price for your solution as an attachment." Considering these documents will have pricing information, is it ok to upload them within the 'Other Attachments' portion of the portal? If so, do they need to be labeled in any certain way? Or, should bidders respond to the Notes area within each 'Line item' to capture this detailed list of exactly what is included in our pricing?
Yes this is acceptable. Please label the documents based on what they contain.
sample: Will Tarrant be using AI tools to evaluate and/or score the responses?

The SAP order documentation the County has shared for the SuccessFactors estate lists Employee Central Payroll, Time Tracking, U.S. Payroll Tax Calculation by BSI, Performance & Goals, Compensation, and U.S. Benefits Administration by Benefitfocus with ACA reporting. It does not list SuccessFactors Employee Central core HR. Employee Central core HR appears instead under RFO F2026018 (Carahsoft), on a term running 1 December 2025 to 30 November 2026. Can the County confirm that Employee Central core HR is licensed for the full duration of the implementation, and identify the agreement it sits under? RFP Reference: Scope of Work (SOW) II.A.21, II.A.27.h; RFO F2026018
Yes the County has purchased full SuccessFactors EC licenses.

SuccessFactors Recruiting and SuccessFactors Onboarding were also purchased under RFO F2026018 on the same 1 December 2025 to 30 November 2026 term. Separately, the County holds SmartRecruiters Winston for SAP SuccessFactors. And the Scope of Work records NeoGov as the incumbent recruiting system. Which of these three is the intended target for recruiting, and which of the others are being retired? RFP Reference: SOW II.A.15.f, II.A.21.b-d
The County intends on using SmartRecruiters with Winston for SuccessFactors.
